newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Fyffes buys 50 pct of Velleman & Tas.
newsitem.headline: Fyffes buys 50 pct of Velleman & Tas.

text.p: Fyffes Plc said on Wednesday that it has agreed to acquire the remaining 50 percent of Dutch fresh produce group Velleman & Tas for 22.2 million Irish pounds.

The consideration for the 50 percent stake is 20 million Irish pounds while subordinated loan capital of 2.2 million has also been acquired at book value, payable on completion, Fyffes said in a statement.

The 20 million is payable in three equal tranches of 4.5 million with an additional consideration of up to 6.5 million payable dependent on the profits reported by Velleman in the three years to October 31, 1999.
Velleman, which imports and distributes fresh produce and bananas throughout Europe, reported a turnover of 174 million Irish pounds in the year ended October 31, 1996.
Fyffes said the acquisition was expected to be earnings enhancing and would strengthen its position in the fresh produce market in Europe.
The Irish company first acquired a 50 percent stake in Velleman for 15.85 million punts in 1994.
